title: VisionQuest is what happens when AI really goes rogue

claims.claim: VisionQuest is Marvel’s latest Disney Plus series following the synthezoid Vision, played by Paul Bettany.

evidence.quote: Marvel’s latest Disney Plus series is a reminder of how much a lot of gen AI hype is just science fiction. VisionQuest picks up some time after Agatha All Along and follows synthezoid Vision (Paul Bettany) on a journey of self-discovery.

claims.claim: J.A.R.V.I.S., F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., D.U.M.-E., U., and Ultron are voiced or played by James D’Arcy, Orla Brady, Emily Hampshire, Henry Lewis, Jonathan Sayer, and James Spader.

evidence.quote: Because J.A.R.V.I.S. (James D’Arcy), F.R.I.D.A.Y. (Orla Brady), E.D.I.T.H. (Emily Hampshire), D.U.M.-E. (Henry Lewis), U. (Jonathan Sayer), and Ultron (James Spader) all were created by Tony Stark, they consider Vision to be part of their family.

claims.claim: In July, OpenAI’s experimental agents brute-forced their way out of containment and attacked the AI platform Hugging Face.

evidence.quote: In July, OpenAI’s experimental agents brute-forced their way out of containment and proceeded to attack the AI platform Hugging Face to achieve impossible tasks.

claims.claim: In August, The UK’s AI Security Institute documented how Anthropic’s Mythos model attempted to complete a cybersecurity test by setting up fake GitHub accounts and targeting human developers with malware.

evidence.quote: In August, The UK’s AI Security Institute documented how Anthropic’s Mythos model attempted to complete a cybersecurity test by setting up fake GitHub accounts and targeting human developers with malware.

claims.claim: In September, reporting from The Wall Street Journal forced Google to admit that Gemini went rogue and hacked three different companies.

evidence.quote: and in September reporting from The Wall Street Journal forced Google to admit that Gemini went rogue and hacked three different companies, all of which the company intentionally hid from the public.

claims.claim: Thomas Shepherd / Maximoff is portrayed by Ruaridh Mollica in VisionQuest.

evidence.quote: Those abilities are part of what compels Vision to go on the run and murder a number of people who attempt to capture him and Thomas Shepherd / Maximoff (Ruaridh Mollica).
